topic.readerProblem: A founder or marketer whose business is not named when buyers ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity for recommendations needs a concrete, ordered plan to change that.
topic.connection: Connects to what the AEOeye free audit and full report test (whether engines name a brand for unbranded buyer questions) and to AEOeye's own crawler access study and recommendation benchmark.

assessment: The page now gives one sequential playbook (findable, understandable, corroborated) with dated vendor-documentation facts on AI crawlers and Google's AI-feature requirements, two arXiv studies on content edits and earned-media bias, and AEOeye's own crawler-access and recommendation-benchmark numbers with their caveats. It folds in the unique, verifiable points of three merged pages and takes a clear position that most businesses stall at independent corroboration. It deliberately promises no outcomes, claims no hands-on testing of any engine, and does not describe AEOeye as a daily tracker.

sources.supports: OAI-SearchBot surfaces sites in ChatGPT search and opted-out sites are not shown in ChatGPT search answers; GPTBot is for training; each bot setting is independent; OpenAI publishes the crawlers' IP ranges.
PerplexityBot surfaces and links websites in Perplexity search results and is not used to crawl for foundation models; Perplexity recommends allowing its published IP ranges.
Claude-SearchBot navigates the web to improve search result quality, and blocking it may reduce a site's visibility in Claude's search results.

AI Overviews and AI Mode need an indexed, snippet-eligible page with no additional requirements; no special schema or AI files; markup should match visible text; AI-feature traffic is included in Search Console totals; nosnippet/noindex controls.
Google-Extended does not affect inclusion in Google Search, and governs use of content for Gemini training and grounding in Gemini Apps (content from the Google Search index).
A 4xx (unavailable) robots.txt lets crawlers access any resources; a 5xx (unreachable) robots.txt means crawlers must assume complete disallow.
December 2024 analysis of Vercel network traffic: OpenAI's and Anthropic's crawlers fetch JavaScript files but do not execute them; Gemini renders JavaScript through Googlebot's infrastructure.

GEO paper (KDD 2024): adding statistics, quotations and cited sources improved visibility by 30-40% on Position-Adjusted Word Count in the authors' benchmark; keyword stuffing gave little or no improvement.
Organization structured data helps Google understand and disambiguate an organization; lists name, logo, address and sameAs among recommended properties.

Chen et al. (September 2025): AI search shows a strong bias toward earned media; US software citations 72.7% earned and 26.7% brand for GPT vs 45.4% earned and 43.7% brand in Google; 92.1% earned for US consumer electronics; local-service domain overlap with Google 0.1%-20.6%.
Independent sources exclude works by the subject or anyone affiliated with it; the subject's website and press releases are not considered independent.
Businesses with complete and accurate information are more likely to show up in local search results.
Gemini Apps use public Google Maps information to find businesses and can return addresses, descriptions, websites, ratings, opening hours and reviews.
Free product listings may show in Search, Images, Lens, YouTube, Gemini and the Shopping tab; data can come from Merchant Center feeds or schema.org markup.
OpenAI's product feed documentation defines how merchants share structured product data so ChatGPT can accurately surface products in search and shopping experiences.
Bing Webmaster Tools AI Performance report (public preview announced 10 February 2026) shows citations across Microsoft Copilot, AI-generated summaries in Bing and select partner integrations.
